verdict.rationale:
Lorikeet ships an in-product AI assistant ("Coach") that users can talk to directly inside Lorikeet, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, or via MCP, and its MCP server exposes delegate-able tasks (diagnose tickets, audit knowledge bases, build workflows via natural language, test tools, run simulations) confirmed live via runtime probes of the hosted MCP endpoint. This directly matches the story of delegating tasks to a built-in assistant.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of delegating tasks (all evidence is vendor docs/probes), and clearer distinction of Coach as a standalone in-app assistant versus MCP-mediated external LLM use.
